verdicts.one_liner: Graves is now a popular hard counter to his traps; drop from A to B.
verdicts.direct: Graves' gun destroys his pre-placed traps, so trap zoning — his main lane tool — is deleted in any lobby with a Graves (now a ~40% pick).
verdicts.indirect: Permanent Bullet Resist container rolls tax a gun-bruiser for the whole match, and spread corridors plus Steam Vents open flank angles on a slow tanky gunner.
build_adjustments: Against Graves, hold traps for fight setup instead of pre-placing them as lane vision.

verdicts.one_liner: Roam build gains from vents and corridors; farm build gains nothing.
verdicts.indirect: Steam Vents and corridors feed the Smoke Bomb roamer line, but permanent Bullet Resist container rolls blunt gun damage and Barrel Mimics punish crate-chaining on her squishy frame.
build_adjustments: Play vent ambushes on isolated corridor farmers instead of static camp farming.
Never chain breakables at low HP — a mimic turns a routine clear into a death.

verdicts.one_liner: Untouched by the patch; still a fire-rate gun carry in a roam meta.
Vents give everyone his Shadow Weave engage, and he still spikes too late.
verdicts.indirect: Steam Vents hand every hero the invis-engage he pays Shadow Weave for, so his one exclusivity is gone — and the tempo clock that kills his late gun spike is unchanged.
build_adjustments: Shadow Weave stays the engage shell, but it no longer buys exclusivity.

verdicts.one_liner: Harder camps feed his regen ramp; the tank front line he shreds rose.
verdicts.indirect: Harder camp damage rewards his regen stack, and the rising frontline gives current-HP Serrated Knives more targets — though Steam Vents give divers a free approach before he ramps.

verdicts.one_liner: Free pathing off objectives plus the best camp clear: closest thing to S.
verdicts.direct: Flying Strike now creates paths against solid targets (turrets, Shrines, objectives), so objective-adjacent ults stop whiffing; parry no longer resets on objectives, making a Shrine dive one-shot.
verdicts.indirect: Her punch AoE is still the fastest clear of the grouped, behavior-varied Haunt camps, which is where souls now live.
build_adjustments: Use Flying Strike off a Walker or Guardian to path out, not only to engage.
Plan the Shrine/Walker dive exit before committing — no parry reset to bail you out.

verdicts.one_liner: Camps and new districts love her; the tanks she cannot kill also got better.
verdicts.indirect: Grouped Haunt camps suit her AoE clear and the new off-lane districts give her dive routes, but the frontline archetype rose and tanks are her worst matchups.
build_adjustments: Dive corridor farmers between camps; skip Tough Crates, she has no heavy-melee route.

verdicts.one_liner: Four corridors and vent invisibility give her carbine real hiding spots.
verdicts.indirect: Steam-Vent invisibility and off-lane corridors add fresh Kinetic Carbine pick angles, and Barrel Mimics make crate-chaining lethal for the low-HP clearers she picks on.
build_adjustments: Set picks from Steam Vents and corridors instead of lane brushes.

verdicts.one_liner: The patch deleted lane-shoving as an income strategy; his whole plan was that.
verdicts.indirect: Souls moved off the lanes into corridors and shared objectives, so his split-push pressure converts to less income, and Steam Vents hand roamers a free approach on his map-play.
build_adjustments: If you play him, farm corridors instead of shoving a lane and pick isolated camp clearers with Djinn's Mark.

verdicts.one_liner: Camps and containers both like him; neither build changes.
verdicts.indirect: Grouped, chasing Haunt camps are the main income route and his burn AoE clears them itemless, while Buff Containers' permanent Spirit Resist is a match-long answer he cannot strip.
build_adjustments: Skip Tough Crates entirely — farm grouped camps instead.
In lobbies stacking Spirit Resist rolls, lean on the gun/burn build over pure spirit.

verdicts.one_liner: More roam routes and a map-wide announced target: her kind of map.
verdicts.indirect: Four off-lane corridors plus vent invisibility expand her roam routes, and Bell Tower's top payout is a scheduled gank spot for a lasso pick.
build_adjustments: Pre-place bounce-pad exits near the Bell Tower rope before roping; lasso the farmer, not the escort.

verdicts.one_liner: Melee bruiser with a private income lane and free hiding spots.
verdicts.indirect: Heavy-Melee Tough Crates give his melee core the same uncontestable soul lane the tanks got, and Steam Vents plus new hiding spots fit his stealth-reveal roam — though his counters Dynamo and Mo & Krill also rose.
build_adjustments: Sweep Tough Crates between roams; Stalker stays the first buy.

verdicts.one_liner: Frontline patch helps, but he is still the second-best front line.
verdicts.indirect: Harder camps reward the sustained frontline archetype he lives in, but the slot still reads Mo & Krill and rising anti-tank Shiv is his worst lane.
